verdict.rationale: Connecting Jupyter or an IDE to a compute instance is a fair question for a cloud GPU/compute platform like Modal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions Jupyter, notebooks, VS Code/Cursor, remote IDE connections or shell access. The documented CLI and SDKs cover deployment and environments, not one-step IDE or notebook access.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open Jupyter or connect my IDE (VS Code/Cursor) to the instance in one step
